learning_profile.note: The release largely confirms the preliminary German CPI reading, so immediate forecasts remain MIXED on current facts. ACTIONABLE v2 evidence for low-confidence MIXED next-session forecasts supports confidence 4/10 there; no EARLY_SIGNAL or INSUFFICIENT segment was used to change direction or confidence materially.

predictions.mechanism: German CPI at 2.9% y/y confirms persistent inflation and energy pressure, which supports a firmer ECB/rates premium, but the final reading was broadly expected and therefore provides little fresh directional surprise for the DAX.
predictions.invalidation: A material revision away from the reported inflation profile, a clear dovish ECB surprise, or a sharp post-release rates move would change the balance.

predictions.mechanism: The German inflation confirmation keeps euro-area rate sensitivity elevated ahead of the ECB, but the lack of a meaningful data surprise limits a clean directional edge for the broader Euro Stoxx 50.
predictions.invalidation: A substantially more dovish or hawkish ECB outcome than currently priced, or a large reversal in oil and bond yields, would dominate this signal.

predictions.mechanism: German CPI is relevant to common ECB policy expectations but has a weaker direct link to French equities; expected inflation confirmation and offsetting sector effects leave the CAC 40 without a strong immediate direction.
predictions.invalidation: A large ECB repricing or broad European risk-on/risk-off move would overwhelm the weak country-specific signal.
